We especially thank her for the good advice regarding their ears!

If you want the best for your dog, I highly recommend Mónika! She is very patient, kind and a fantastic professional. The entire grooming was stress-free and professional, and the end result speaks for itself. Thank you so much for the great work! 😊 …

When I was looking for a dog groomer, it was important to me that he was someone who understood mixes and also understood sensitive dogs. It was also important to me that we could work together at the beginning so that Zuma would love grooming. After all, he has a lot of fur, which is why when he sheds - I don't groom him - he can almost drown in it. Regular grooming reduces this and makes him liveable. We go monthly.
At first, Zuma didn't even want to go through the door, but now not only does he happily go through the door, but he almost jumps into the tub by himself, and he also tolerates drying very well compared to him, even though Zuma is a noisy dog. A lot of smoothing, advice, treats and patience, and regularity paid off. Zuma's fur became much softer and shinier, and its quality became better.
When we moved, I went to a grooming shop closer to us. After two visits, we prefer to travel, but I won't leave Zuma in anyone else's hands. We almost had to start training him all over again because unfortunately he ended up in the "wrong" hands. They absolutely couldn't handle Zuma's sensitivity. They couldn't handle him.

If you want professional care for your dog and are looking for someone who understands dogs, I highly recommend Fancy Dog dog cosmetics.
Thank you very much! 🙂 …

Despite this, the beautician was very patient, kind, and knowledgeable, and professionally groomed our old puppy. She did a great job! Thank you very much! 🥰🙏
